summary: Freedom and disruption support imagination and longing. This cooperative pattern asks you to use originality and compassion with awareness.
body: Freedom and disruption support imagination and longing. This cooperative pattern asks you to use originality and compassion with awareness. Visionary ideals expressed in livable ways. The connection is available when you choose to use it; it works best through deliberate practice. In practice, this can show up through freedom and disruption, imagination and longing, and the choices you make when instability or confusion starts running the room.
gift: The gift is originality, compassion, and a more conscious way to work with freedom and disruption and imagination and longing.
shadow: The shadow is instability, confusion, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let freedom and disruption and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Generational and visionary themes rather than a personal day-to-day read.
do: Name how freedom and disruption and imagination and longing are both involved
Turn originality and compassion into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of freedom and disruption or imagination and longing
